definition{
  name: natMember,
  parameters: [value : Nat, values : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((value =? head) || (natMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: allMembers,
  parameters: [wanted : (List Nat), values : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((natMember head values) && (allMembers rest values))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{
  name: sameNats,
  parameters: [left : (List Nat), right : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match left
    | List.nil => (match right | List.nil => true | List.cons other more => false)
    | List.cons head rest => (match right
      | List.nil => false
      | List.cons other more => ((head =? other) && (sameNats rest more)))),
  recursive_argument: left
}

definition{
  name: nonEmpty,
  parameters: [text : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: (if (prim equal text "" : Bool) then false else true)
}

definition{
  name: thresholdOf,
  parameters: [wanted : Nat, records : (List Foundation.Qual::QualityMeasure)],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons head rest => (if ((project head index) =? wanted) then (project head threshold) else (thresholdOf wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: placeholderMeasures,
  parameters: [records : (List Budget)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (match (project head basis)
      | Basis.Placeholder => (cons (project head measure) (placeholderMeasures rest))
      | Basis.Derived => (placeholderMeasures rest)
      | Basis.Measured => (placeholderMeasures rest)
      | Basis.ZeroTolerance => (placeholderMeasures rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{

    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (match (project head verdict)
      | Verdict.Proved => (cons (project head measure) (provedMeasures rest))
      | Verdict.Open => (provedMeasures rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: vectorCount,
  parameters: [vectors : (List Foundation.View.Text.V1.Model::AcceptanceVector)],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match vectors | List.nil => 0 | List.cons head rest => (1 + (vectorCount rest))),
  recursive_argument: vectors
}

definition{
  name: requestLengthAt,
  parameters: [
    position : Nat,
    current : Nat,
    vectors : (List Foundation.View.Text.V1.Model::AcceptanceVector)
  ],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match vectors
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons head rest => (if (position =? current) then (prim length (project head request) : Nat) else (requestLengthAt position (current + 1) rest))),
  recursive_argument: vectors
}

  parameters: [],
  result: (List CheckEvidence),
  body: (cons (record CheckEvidence {requirement := 1, check := "PrismPM#208 generated-view checks for the five accessibility requirements below", status := (ctor EvidenceStatus.Pending "links when the five accessibility checks below link")}) (cons (record CheckEvidence {requirement := 5, check := "PrismPM#208 generated-view check: text contrast of the generated view in the light and dark themes", status := (ctor EvidenceStatus.Pending "PrismPM#208 names no check for this property; the SDK must register one before this evidence can be linked")}) (cons (record CheckEvidence {requirement := 6, check := "PrismPM#208 generated-view journey: keyboard focus remains on the submit control after a check", status := (ctor EvidenceStatus.Pending "PrismPM#208 names no check for this property; the SDK must register one before this evidence can be linked")}) (cons (record CheckEvidence {requirement := 7, check := "PrismPM#208 generated-view check: system colors preserved in forced-colors mode, three-engine journey", status := (ctor EvidenceStatus.Pending "PrismPM#208 added the forced-colors palette to the semantic presentation renderer only; the Text V3 workbench stylesheet this page uses has no forced-colors rule and no journey")}) (cons (record CheckEvidence {requirement := 10, check := "PrismPM#208 generated-view journey: keyboard-only pass over the script box, example selector and submit control", status := (ctor EvidenceStatus.Pending "PrismPM#208 names no check for this property; the SDK must register one before this evidence can be linked")}) (cons (record CheckEvidence {requirement := 11, check := "PrismPM workbench.rs generates the Text V3 page with one status region, role status, aria-live polite and aria-atomic true, that carries each report; PrismPM scripts/text-workbench.test.mjs asserts all three attributes on the generated page", status := (ctor EvidenceStatus.Linked)}) (nil CheckEvidence)))))))
}

definition{
  name: evidenceRequirements,
  parameters: [records : (List CheckEvidence)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head requirement) (evidenceRequirements rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: evidenceHonest,
  parameters: [records : (List CheckEvidence)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((nonEmpty (project head check)) && ((match (project head status)
      | EvidenceStatus.Linked => true
      | EvidenceStatus.Pending reason => (nonEmpty reason)) && (evidenceHonest rest)))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: pendingEvidence,
  parameters: [records : (List CheckEvidence)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (match (project head status)
      | EvidenceStatus.Linked => (pendingEvidence rest)
      | EvidenceStatus.Pending reason => (cons (project head requirement) (pendingEvidence rest)))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: requirementsUnder,
  parameters: [wanted : Nat, records : (List Foundation.Qual::QualityRequirement)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (if ((project head subcharacteristicIndex) =? wanted) then (cons (project head index) (requirementsUnder wanted rest)) else (requirementsUnder wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: zeroToleranceMeasures,
  parameters: [records : (List Budget)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (match (project head basis)
      | Basis.ZeroTolerance => (cons (project head measure) (zeroToleranceMeasures rest))
      | Basis.Derived => (zeroToleranceMeasures rest)
      | Basis.Measured => (zeroToleranceMeasures rest)
      | Basis.Placeholder => (zeroToleranceMeasures rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: zeroThresholds,
  parameters: [wanted : (List Nat), records : (List Foundation.Qual::QualityMeasure)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => (((thresholdOf head records) =? 0) && (zeroThresholds rest records))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{
  name: evidenceValid,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((evidenceHonest (accessibilityEvidence)) && ((allMembers (requirementsUnder 0 (requirementRecords)) (evidenceRequirements (accessibilityEvidence))) && (allMembers (evidenceRequirements (accessibilityEvidence)) (requirementIndexes (requirementRecords)))))
}

definition{
  name: qualityValid,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bool,
  body: (((sameNats (namedIndexes (characteristicNames)) (characteristicIndexes (characteristicRecords))) && ((sameNats (namedIndexes (subcharacteristicNames)) (subcharacteristicIndexes (subcharacteristicRecords))) && ((sameNats (namedIndexes (requirementNames)) (requirementIndexes (requirementRecords))) && ((allMembers (subcharacteristicParents (subcharacteristicRecords)) (characteristicIndexes (characteristicRecords))) && ((allMembers (characteristicIndexes (characteristicRecords)) (subcharacteristicParents (subcharacteristicRecords))) && ((allMembers (requirementParents (requirementRecords)) (subcharacteristicIndexes (subcharacteristicRecords))) && ((allMembers (measureRequirements (measureRecords)) (requirementIndexes (requirementRecords))) && ((allMembers (requirementIndexes (requirementRecords)) (measureRequirements (measureRecords))) && ((sameNats (budgetMeasures (budgets)) (measureIndexes (measureRecords))) && (budgetsSourced (budgets))))))))))) && (evidenceValid))
}
